metadata.title: Home-lab bounded-context GLM 5.3 EXL3 DFlash2 dual-Spark profile
metadata.description: Home-lab evaluation wrapper derived from MiaAI-Lab 493cb88f: initial 65,536-token context, two sequences, 0.80 utilization, and an experimental 116 GB startup envelope plus 8 GB system reserve. Bounded context from 4,096 to 1,000,000 tokens and one to four sequences preserve the exact K7 draft, TP2, FP8 target KV, controller rendezvous, and K-pool tail-slot correctness fix. Larger context, quality, and throughput require separate qualification.

removal_condition: Remove only after stock vLLM supports the exact GLM 5.3 NoPE sparse-MLA, EXL3, DFlash2, hybrid-KV, reasoning, tool, and SM121 behavior and the two-Spark qualification is repeated.
